scope: Bounded independently validated HCurl Newton/AMS, scalar/dipole Laplace FMM and flat P1 boundary operators
classification: Formal same-host NGSolve(A100) CPU/GPU evaluation, explicitly authorized by user
cold_definition: First numerical API call per case in one fresh owned process; process imports, MATLAB startup and GPU initialization recorded separately
memory_limits: Exact native owned bounds and device-free endpoint samples plus 50ms host-process samples; no global-device/CUDA runtime transient peak certification
publication_notes: Timings unchanged from recovered original JSON; added case descriptions and measurement limitations only
CPU process setup/import time excludes interpreter launch and includes payload verification
MATLAB process memory samples also cover result-file serialization, which is excluded from numerical API timing
FMM CPU baseline is independent NumPy direct summation, not an optimized CPU FMM; no general native CPU-FMM speed claim

physical.cpu: NumPy direct shared sphere SL/cloud, DL and weighted current sum
physical.gpu: Public BEM SL/DL, Biot-Savart and fieldCloud APIs, rebuilt per sample

boundary.cpu: Independent NGSolve flat P1 exterior Galerkin SL/DL, bonus quadrature 16
boundary.gpu: Native mapped P1 quadrature and shared exact-near correction plus CUDA FMM, complete setup each sample
